label: LightONKaroo
description: Manual ANT+ and Bluetooth bike light control for Hammerhead Karoo 3 with Software Threat Mode and iGPSPORT smart light support.
releaseNotes:
* Magicshine & iGPSPORT 6 Custom Slots: 6 Custom Slots with 0-100% sliders, pattern selection (Steady, Flash, SOS/Breath) & disk persistence
* v0.1.6-R2: Fixed iGPSPORT VS1800S dual-beam controls fallback after device reboot / fresh install
* iGPSPORT BLE Smart Light Integration: Full support for VS1800S (Dual Beam) & VS1200S/VS800S/VS500 (Single Beam)
* ANT+ Light Command AIDL Fix: Dynamic descriptor discovery (LightCommandConnectionAIDL at TX 18) restoring full ANT+ control
* Ravemen FR300 pre-OFF mode filtering: Prevents status sticking when light is turned OFF
